scope: Dense piano-roll workload: drawing, edit and input latency before and after a single painted note view
environment: Kvant: AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-core (24 threads), host load average 21-24 from unrelated jobs; pinned CI image, docker --network none; Qt 6.12 offscreen platform, software scene graph (graphics API 1), window 1060x1000, device pixel ratio 1, grid 980x132 px
workload: 1024 notes over 16 bars (6144 ticks): note k starts at 6k, lasts 90 ticks (clipped at 16 bars), pitch 48 + 7k mod 24, velocity 40 + k mod 60; at most 15 sounding at once

before.note: one QML Rectangle per note and per grid line; note list rebuilt on every 10 ms session tick; three runs

after.note: PianoNotesView painted item, notesChanged notification, scalar bindings, O(n log n) voice check; three runs

verified_behaviors: Clicking the middle of 20 different notes on the dense grid selects exactly that note's ID
A keyboard move keeps the selection and Delete removes the note (1023 left)
Idle frames cause no repaint of the note view
All earlier piano-roll tests pass with the painted view; the selected colour is checked in the rendered window image
observed_limits: An edit to the dense clip still takes about 25 ms (document preparation and validation); GPU scene graph, native Wayland and display scaling are unmeasured; single host under background load.
